limits: No network/LLM/API. Same R4 catalog API, not a public benchmark.
Known transition and relevance, finite state, exact initial and runtime calibration remain.
Only paid atomic labels are visible to calibration selectors. No dense hidden table in selector.
Training catalog reference answers are permitted supervision, separately counted; runtime gold never enters policy.
Diagonal/irrelevant-bit invariances use public implementation contracts and tested, not estimated.
All selectors pay equal marginal cost per acquired canonical interaction cell: 16 workflow executions.
Selection uses immediate decision stress sensitivity, not a general VOI optimum or new theorem.
Four separate training panels; nested budgets share acquisition prefixes explicitly.
No testing labels used for method or parameter selection; all conditions and seeds retained.
No retraining or wins-based tuning after results. Negative results remain.
User reproduction uses same data, adds no independent sample.
RepairLens has no new experiments in this round.

statistics.unit: paired independent evaluation stream conditional on calibration panel; do not claim population-training uncertainty

audit.discrete_science: strict values AND types; arrays ordered

selection.scope: hypothetical public states; no evaluation catalogs, hidden states, gold labels or outcomes
